auth.welcomeHint: Sign in to read and keep the family's gia phả.
auth.forgotHint: Forgot your password? Ask the clan head to reset it.
auth.proverb: Cây có cội, nước có nguồn
auth.proverbNote: A tree has its roots, a river its source.
auth.privateNote: A private family record — only relatives given an account can read it.

nav.sidebarHint: The pages of the gia phả

dashboard.subtitle: Keep the roots, remember the giỗ, and carry the family line on for those who come after.
dashboard.upcomingHint: Kept by the lunar calendar, shown in solar dates
dashboard.pendingHintReviewer: Sent in by members, waiting for an editor
dashboard.pendingHintMember: Your suggestions still waiting for review
dashboard.nextGioEmpty: No giỗ in the next 30 days.
dashboard.loadFailed: The figures could not be loaded.

notFound.title: This page does not exist
notFound.body: The address may be mistyped, or the page has moved elsewhere.

member.subtitle: Who may sign in to the gia phả. The clan head opens accounts, changes roles, disables them, and resets forgotten passwords here.
member.createHint: Hand the first password over in person; they can change it once signed in.
member.editHint: Changing the role or disabling the account signs them out on every device.
member.editSelfHint: This is your own account: you cannot change your own role or disable yourself, or nobody would be left to manage the clan.

roleHint.MEMBER: Member: reads the gia phả and suggests corrections.
roleHint.EDITOR: Editor: adds and edits people and events, reviews suggestions.
roleHint.ADMIN: Clan head: everything, deleting and managing accounts included.

member.changePasswordHint: Changing it ends every session you have, this one included, and you sign in again with the new password.
member.resetPasswordHint: They will be signed out everywhere. Tell them the new password in person, not over a shared chat.
member.passwordChanged: Password changed. Sign in again with the new one.

validation.tooShort: The new password needs at least {{min}} characters
validation.tooLong: Password too long. Use a shorter one: accented letters take more room, about 24 of them at most
validation.mismatch: The two new passwords do not match
validation.sameAsCurrent: The new password must differ from the current one

person.title: People
person.subtitle: Everyone recorded in the gia phả
person.name: Name
person.deleteDescription: Their events, photos, citations and suggestions are deleted too. The change history is kept.

validation.givenNameRequired: At least one name is needed

person.redactedHint: This person is living, so details are for the clan head and editors only. You can still offer a note below.
person.redactedDates: Dates are hidden because this person is living

family.deceasedHint: A person with no death recorded counts as living and is hidden from members.
family.datesNotSaved: The person was added, but their birth or death could not be saved. Add it on their page.
family.orderIndexHint: 0 is the first spouse, 1 the second, and so on.
family.deleteUnionDescription: Its wedding date, photos and citations are deleted too. It can only be deleted with no children linked: it has {{count}} now, so unlink them from the union first.
family.noUnionEventsOrHidden: No events recorded yet, or hidden because the couple is living
family.birthOrderHint: 1 is the eldest. Leave empty if unknown — a wrong guess makes the bác/chú answer wrong.
family.unlinkTitle: Unlink this child from the union?
family.unlinkDescription: They stay in the gia phả; they are just no longer recorded as this couple's child.

validation.orderNumber: Order must be a number, 0 or more
validation.birthOrder: Birth order must be a number, 1 or more

event.title: Events
event.deleteDescription: The event leaves the gia phả; the change history keeps the date it recorded.

date.hint: A year on its own is enough. Accepts about / before / after, or a range of years.
date.unparsed: Could not read that as a date - what you typed is kept verbatim.
date.hintLunar: A lunar date. For a leap month add “leap”, e.g. 10/4 leap/2020. A giỗ with no known year: day/month only, e.g. 12/3.
date.yearless: A lunar day with no known year can be saved; as a death date, its giỗ is still reminded every year.

quality.title: Data quality
quality.subtitle: Things worth a second look - warnings, never blocking a save

codes.ANCESTRY_CYCLE: Is their own ancestor - the parent chain loops back to this person
codes.CONFLICTING_DATES: Two recorded {{type}} dates cannot both be right
codes.BORN_AFTER_MOTHER_DEATH: Born after the mother ({{related}}) had died
codes.BORN_LONG_AFTER_FATHER_DEATH: Born long after the father ({{related}}) died
codes.BORN_LONG_AFTER_PARENT_DEATH: Born long after the parent ({{related}}) died
codes.MOTHER_TOO_YOUNG: The mother ({{related}}) was only {{age}} at the birth
codes.MOTHER_TOO_OLD: The mother ({{related}}) was {{age}} at the birth
codes.MARRIED_BEFORE_BIRTH: Marriage recorded before their own birth
codes.POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE: May be the same person as {{related}}

merge.title: Merge two records
merge.warning: A merge cannot be undone. The deleted record's relations, events, grave, citations and suggestions move to the surviving one; its names are kept as alternates.
merge.reason: What makes these the same person?
merge.reasonPlaceholder: Matched the headstone, same ngày giỗ, what the eldest uncle said...
merge.reasonRequired: A basis is required — this is what a later reader sees in the change history.
merge.summary: Merged. {{name}} is the record that survived.

suggestion.title: Edit suggestions
suggestion.subtitle: Members offer what they know; the clan head approves before it enters the gia phả
suggestion.subtitleMine: What you have offered, and what the clan head decided

offer.UPDATE: Propose a correction to the name, sex, birth or death date
offer.CREATE: Propose a child or spouse of this person

suggestion.updateHint: Fill in only what should change; blank keeps it. A new name becomes the primary one and the old is kept as an alternate.
suggestion.createHint: The new person is added to this person's family when the clan head approves.
suggestion.message: What do you know about this person?
suggestion.messagePlaceholder: Grandmother said he also had an art name; he may have died in the year of the Rat...
suggestion.reasonRequired: A rejection needs a reason, so the suggester knows why.
suggestion.noteReview: This is a note and changes nothing in the gia phả. Acknowledge it, then edit the person yourself if needed.
suggestion.unreadable: This suggestion's content cannot be read; it can only be rejected.

validation.nothingProposed: Fill in at least one thing to change: name, sex, birth or death date

data.title: Export / import
data.subtitle: The gia phả belongs to the family - take it anywhere, it is not locked in this app
data.noAccess: The GEDCOM file and the printed book carry every detail of living people, so only editors and the clan head can download them. Ask one of them for a copy.
data.exportHint: GEDCOM 7.0 is the format every genealogy program reads. The PDF is for printing as a book, split by generation.
data.importHint: Reads GEDCOM 5.5.1 and 7.0. The file must be UTF-8.
data.result: Added {{persons}} people, {{families}} families, {{events}} events, {{sources}} sources, {{citations}} citations.
data.skipped: Skipped {{n}} records this app does not model.
data.dropped: {{n}} records this app does model could not be kept — see the list below.
data.duplicateHint: An import adds, it never merges. If the file overlaps people you already have, see

audit.title: Change history
audit.pageSubtitle: Who changed what in the gia phả, when and why — newest first

source.title: Title
source.author: Author / teller
source.dateTextPlaceholder: 1923, around the Bảo Đại era, unknown...
source.repositoryPlaceholder: The clan hall, the senior branch's house, a library...
source.locatorPlaceholder: page 12, back of the headstone, 14:30 into the recording...
source.quotePlaceholder: Quote the source verbatim, so a later reader can judge it
source.removeCitationDescription: The source stays; only this citation goes. The change history keeps its quote.
source.pageSubtitle: Old clan books, accounts, documents, headstones - the basis for each line of the genealogy
source.deleteDescription: Only a source with no citations and no scans can be deleted. Merge a cited source into another instead.
source.mergeDescription_one: This source's one citation moves to the source kept, then this source is deleted. A citation at the same place is folded in, keeping both quotes.
source.mergeDescription_other: This source's {{count}} citations move to the source kept, then this source is deleted. Citations at the same place are folded in, keeping both quotes.
source.mergeReason: Why these are the same source
source.mergeReasonPlaceholder: e.g. the same handwritten clan book, entered twice

validation.sourceRequired: Pick a source, or name a new one

media.title: Photos & scans
media.caption: Caption
media.captionPlaceholder: E.g. taken in the home village in 1960
media.deleteDescription: {{name}} will be removed from storage for good. The history still records the deletion.
media.loadFailed: The photos could not be loaded. Reload the page.
media.hint: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, HEIC or PDF, up to 20 MB each. Several files can be picked at once.
media.portraitHint: The portrait is shown on this person's page and in the book; it must be JPEG, PNG or GIF.
media.onePortrait: A person has one portrait - pick a single file.
media.openOriginal: Open the original in a new tab
media.notPreviewable: This file cannot be previewed here.

validation.sortOrder: The position is a whole number, 0 or more

grave.title: Grave
grave.kindHint: A grave counts as a recorded death. A sinh phần is a plot built for someone still living, and stays as private as anything else about the living.
grave.plotPlaceholder: section B, row 3, plot 12 - or free description
grave.deleteDescription: Its photos and citations go with it. For a reburial, correct the location and record a “Reburial” event instead.

coordinates.title: Coordinates
coordinates.hint: Optional, but both or neither. A “21.028511, 105.804817” pair copied from Google Maps can be pasted into either field.
coordinates.latitudeInvalid: Latitude must be a number from -90 to 90
coordinates.longitudeInvalid: Longitude must be a number from -180 to 180
coordinates.bothOrNeither: Give both latitude and longitude, or neither

kinship.title: Kinship
kinship.noRelation: No blood relation found between these two

anniversary.title: Death anniversaries
anniversary.subtitle: Upcoming ngày giỗ, on the Vietnamese lunar calendar
anniversary.empty: No anniversaries fall in this window
anniversary.approximate: The day of death is only approximate, so this anniversary is too

tree.title: Family tree
tree.startHint: The tree opens on the clan's founder; click someone to centre it on them.
tree.noFounder: There is no tree to draw: no union is recorded yet, or the relations form a loop (someone is their own ancestor). Add people and relations, or see the Data quality page.
tree.empty: Not enough data to draw a chart yet
tree.truncatedAbove: There are older generations beyond this view - raise the generation count to see them.
tree.truncatedBelow: There are descendants beyond this view - raise the generation count to see them.
tree.hint: Drag to pan, scroll to zoom. Click a name to centre the chart on that person.
tree.legend: Dashed line: adopted, step or foster child. Dashed box with ↺: already drawn elsewhere on this chart. Numbered circles: which marriage the children belong to.

common.changeNoteTooLong: The reason is longer than {{max}} characters
common.changeNote: Reason for the change (kept in the history)
common.changeNotePlaceholder: E.g. per the senior branch's handwritten gia phả

place.title: Places
place.subtitle: Villages in communes, communes in districts, districts in provinces - rename a place once and every event there follows
place.name: Name
place.parentHint: Leave empty for the top level. The parent must be a wider level; “Other” fits anywhere.
place.addMissing: Not listed? Add a new place
place.deleteDescription: Refused while an event, a grave or a smaller place is recorded here.

branch.title: Clan branches
branch.subtitle: Chi, phái and nhánh, as a tree
branch.name: Name
branch.deleteDescription: Refused while anyone still belongs to it or a sub-branch still sits beneath it.
